Design Considerations

  • Use soft gradient background to differentiate from organic content without being jarring
  • "Sponsored" label must always be visible (top-right, with sparkle icon)
  • Banner should not interrupt the reading flow — use between logical section breaks
  • Max 1 inline banner per page load to avoid ad fatigue
  • Dismissed banners should not reappear for 24 hours (stored in planner_ad_preferences)

Event Tracking Flow

Every ad interaction is tracked through these 12 event types, flowing into the ad_events collection and rolled up nightly into ad_stats_daily.

User Interaction Pipeline

impression_served → impression_viewable → hover → click → vendor_profile_view → contact_click → lead_created → vendor_responded → lead_accepted

Awareness

impression_served
impression_viewable

Engagement

hover, click
vendor_profile_view

Intent

contact_click
lead_created, vendor_invited

Conversion

vendor_responded
lead_accepted, vendor_added_to_wedding

Data Captured Per Event

Core Fields

  • • event_type — which interaction occurred
  • • sponsored_vendor_id — ad unit ID
  • • vendor_profile_id — the vendor being promoted
  • • placement — where the ad was shown
  • • planner_id — who saw/clicked the ad
  • • wedding_id — which wedding context

Attribution Fields

  • • click_id — UUID linking click to lead
  • • session_id — browser session tracking
  • • created_at — UTC timestamp
  • • metadata — viewport, scroll depth, etc.

Nightly Rollup Pipeline

Raw events are aggregated nightly at 2:00 AM UTC into ad_stats_daily for fast dashboard queries

ad_events → $match (day) → $group (vendor+placement) → $merge (upsert) → ad_stats_daily
Schedule
2:00 AM UTC daily
Raw TTL
90 days (auto-cleanup)
Rollup Retention
Indefinite
